ST-01.title: Dark-theme secondary-text contrast fix (BLG-FE-87)
ST-01.notes: AC-01: systematic replacement of bare text-slate-500 -> text-slate-400 across src/pages + src/components, per ux_spec.md §3/§6 canonical dark value (5.71:1 vs bg-slate-800, was 3.07:1 FAIL). Method: reproduced audit grep (contrast_audit_findings.md), 259 bare text-slate-500 instances found (matches audit's 262 within normal drift), 226 in-scope text instances replaced across 59 files, 33 icon-only instances (Lucide components, WCAG 1.4.11 scope per ux_spec.md §5) correctly excluded and left unchanged. Verified via full Babel/JSX parse of all 159 touched-directory files: 0 syntax errors. AC-02: spot-check computed in ux_spec.md §3 (text-slate-400 vs bg-slate-950/900/800 = worst case 5.71:1 vs bg-slate-800, PASS at 4.5:1 threshold) applies uniformly since all replaced instances are the same literal class -> class substitution; representative sample manually diff-reviewed: TradePlan.js, Settings.js, TradeHistory.js, StrategyCompliancePanel.js, AiChatWidget.js. AC-03: Playwright coverage added — tests/e2e/secondary-text-contrast.spec.js (SC-CTR-01a/01b), run locally and confirmed passing (2/2) against the actual fix: computed color resolves to rgb(148, 163, 184) [slate-400], not rgb(100, 116, 139) [slate-500]. Cross-spec selector check (LL-v3.2-P3-02, SC-06): scanned tests/e2e/ for .text-slate-500 selectors against elements this story modified (TradeHistoryTable.js rColour/slippageColour null-case, Research.js news caption) — found and fixed 3 stale selectors in the same commit: fee-drag-trade-history.spec.js, slippage-tracking.spec.js, research-typography.spec.js. All 3 files + secondary-text-contrast.spec.js re-run and confirmed passing after the fix.

ST-02.title: Light-theme secondary-text contrast fix (BLG-FE-88)
ST-02.notes: AC-01: added text-slate-600 (light bare) / dark:text-slate-400 pairing to every in-scope bare text-slate-400 instance (697 instances, 101 files) per ux_spec.md §3 canonical pair (6.92:1 vs bg-slate-100, was 2.34-2.56:1 FAIL bare). Also fixed 1 broken pre-existing pairing (StatsCard.js:92 had text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-400 - light half never updated) and applied the exception treatment for the Dashboard Advisory Label (AiDailyBriefing.js:141: text-slate-300 -> text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300, per ux_spec.md §4 - not the generic token, dark value preserved unchanged). 29 icon-only instances excluded per §5. Verified via full Babel/JSX parse of all 159 touched-directory files: 0 syntax errors. AC-02: prioritised naturally by ST-01's file set (top-traffic pages already covered: Positions, Screener, Reports, TradeEntry, Research, Settings per contrast_audit_findings.md top-10 list). AC-03: extended tests/e2e/secondary-text-contrast.spec.js with SC-CTR-02a/02b (light theme via localStorage theme=light + addInitScript), confirmed passing (4/4 total) with computed color rgb(71,85,105) [slate-600] in light theme, rgb(148,163,184) [slate-400] in dark. Cross-spec selector check (LL-v3.2-P3-02): 3 stale .text-slate-400 CSS class selectors found and fixed (fee-drag-trade-history.spec.js, slippage-tracking.spec.js, research-typography.spec.js) - Tailwind's dark: variant makes the paired class a distinct classList token ('dark:text-slate-400'), so a bare '.text-slate-400' selector no longer matches; updated to '.text-slate-600' (the new light-mode base class). toHaveClass(/text-slate-400/) regex-based assertions (r-multiple-reflection.spec.js, visual-snapshots.spec.js) were unaffected — substring match against the full className string still succeeds. Full e2e suite: 428 passed, 3 skipped (pre-existing), 1 failed on first run (alert-nav-badge.spec.js SC-ANB-05, unrelated timing flake - confirmed pre-existing by re-running 3x in isolation, all passed; no text-slate reference in that test or its underlying component).
